results.flow_input_to_sink: Permissionless caller context (msg.sender) triggers release of the settled sponsorProceeds storage balance to the stored sponsorRecipient address and is recorded as the indexed caller in the SponsorProceedsReleased event.
results.flow_security_relevance: Executes an external ERC-20 transfer of all accumulated sponsor quote-token proceeds and zeroes the sponsorProceeds accounting liability; requires verification of CEI ordering, reentrancy protection, settlement math, and recipient validation.
results.flow_summary: When sponsorProceeds is nonzero and sponsorRecipient passes runtime protocol-destination screening, releaseSponsorProceeds() zeroes sponsorProceeds, transfers the full quoteToken balance to sponsorRecipient via SafeERC20.safeTransfer, emits SponsorProceedsReleased, and returns the transferred amount.
results.flow_terminal_action: External ERC-20 transfer quoteToken.safeTransfer(sponsorRecipient, amount) followed by emitting SponsorProceedsReleased(msg.sender, recipient, amount) and returning amount.
